seoTitle: Sitechecker vs Growth Audit — Compare Website Checks
metaDescription: Compare Sitechecker with Growth Audit by scope, evidence and workflow. Choose a website check that fits your small-business needs.
intro: Sitechecker and Growth Audit address overlapping website review needs with different scopes. Compare the evidence you need before treating their scores or feature lists as interchangeable.
competitorStrengths: A platform for agencies managing multiple client websites
Website crawling and change monitoring tools
Keyword ranking and Search Console data tools described on its official site
ourStrengths: A free one-off audit without creating an account
Plain-English priorities across SEO, performance, automated accessibility, trust, mobile, conversion and relevant local SEO
A downloadable report and optional monitoring plans for small-business websites
verdict: Consider Sitechecker when its specialist SEO features match your task. Start with Growth Audit when you want a broad, understandable website diagnosis. Growth Audit uses a bounded sample rather than an exhaustive large-site crawl and does not replace keyword ranking or backlink databases. Neither a score nor this comparison guarantees a search position or extra enquiries. Check official pages for current features and terms.
